# FireResist

> > FireResist provides certified fireproof doors, windows, curtain walls and smoke vents engineered for UK building safety compliance and passive fire protection.

FireResist specializes in fire-rated building systems designed to meet UK safety standards and regulations. The company offers a comprehensive range of products including fireproof doors (FD30-FD120), fire-rated windows (EW30-EI60), curtain walls, and smoke vents, with detailed technical specifications and certification documentation.

## Key Topics

- Fire-rated systems
- Passive fire protection
- Fireproof doors (FD30-FD120)
- Fire-rated windows (EI30-EI60)
- Fire-rated curtain walls
- MB-78EI partition walls
- MB-86 EI windows
- MB-118EI systems
- Smoke vents and exhaust
- Building compartmentation
- Thermal insulation
- Aluminum profiles
- EN 13501-2:2016-07 compliance
- RC2 security
- Commercial and residential applications

## Core Products

- [Fireproof Doors - Fire Rated Doors](https://fireresist.co.uk/fire-rated-systems/fireproof-doors): FireResist fireproof doors (FD30-FD120) meeting UK safety standards and regulations
- [Fireproof Windows - Fire Rated Windows](https://fireresist.co.uk/fire-rated-systems/fireproof-windows): FireResist fireproof windows (EW30-EI60) with fire safety and UK compliance
- [Fire Rated Curtain Wall - Safety & Compliance](https://fireresist.co.uk/fire-rated-systems/fire-rated-curtain-walls): FireResist fire-rated curtain walls (EI30-EI120) for building compartmentation
- [Smoke Vents - Smoke Vent Systems](https://fireresist.co.uk/fire-rated-systems/smoke-vents): FireResist smoke vents and exhaust systems for fire safety compliance

## Product Specifications

- [MB-78EI](https://fireresist.co.uk/products/mb-78ei-6): MB-78EI fire-resistant partition walls with acoustic insulation
- [MB-86 EI D](https://fireresist.co.uk/products/mb-86-ei): MB-86 EI D fire-rated windows/doors (EI30/EI15) with RC2 security
- [MB-86 EI W](https://fireresist.co.uk/products/mb-86-ei-w): MB-86 EI W triple-glazed fire-rated windows with EI30/EI15 ratings
- [MB-118EI](https://fireresist.co.uk/products/mb-118ei): MB-118EI EI120 fire-rated partition system with aluminum profiles
- [MB-60E EI](https://fireresist.co.uk/products/mb-60e-ei): MB-60E EI fire-resistant doors and partitions (EI15/EI30)
- [MB-SR50N EI](https://fireresist.co.uk/products/mb-sr50n-ei-mb-sr50n-ei-efekt): MB-SR50N EI fireproof curtain walls (EI30-EI60) with angled designs
- [MB-78EI DPA](https://fireresist.co.uk/products/mb-78ei-dpa): MB-78EI DPA automatic sliding fire-resistant doors (EI15/EI30)
- [Smoke Exhaust Windows and Roof Vents](https://fireresist.co.uk/products/smoke-exhaust-windows-and-roof-vents): FireResist smoke exhaust windows and roof vents for fire safety
